verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page lists "Custom workflows and reporting", which is a first-party claim of custom reports. Nothing shows that an accountant can build those reports themselves, or that they can be filtered or grouped by class, location, or tag. Missing for 10: documented filtering by class, location, or tag; documented grouping by those dimensions; evidence of self-serve report building rather than reports prepared by Pilot staff; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
